venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 7/23.** MOD JK / MKz. Net $1,716 vs target $2,202 (-22%). 60 guests, $28.61 check avg, comps $16.90. No opening bartender — JK stepped in as opener, handling prep and a work meeting at once; he's been stepping in all week with multiple employees sick or out of town. Barback prepped for the weekend; closer reset glassware to standard now that pitchers aren't needed. Decent early push that died down around 7pm, with familiar faces and lots of industry folk through the night. Note: the new quick screen has thrown off some numbers — food sales are actually higher than listed. Maintenance: gasket on fire cooler coming loose. Favorite moment: so many birthdays in the house.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 7/23.** MOD KE, KK / Chef JMS. Net $1,661 vs target $3,737 (-56%). 52 guests, $31.95 check avg, comps $61.95 (3.7%, mostly return guests/neighbors/F&F). Slow up front — the majority of guests arrived after 8pm, with pops at ~8pm and ~11pm, mostly larger groups celebrating birthdays and engagements. Team completed bar rotations to deliver check-ins. ABC was running sting operations in the area tonight — team was thorough with IDs and made it through unscathed; stings may continue through the weekend, so pre-shift diligence continues. Kitchen: decent food sales, JM the champ. Maintenance: leak under the freezer appears to have returned late in the shift. Favorite moment: a rowdy-but-respectful late crew turning a birthday into a 'bachelor party' to fit Bachelorette Nation.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Light sprinkle at sundown, muggy but nice
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 7/23.** AM MOD Chef Josh & Maggie S; PM MOD Evan & Maggie S. Total net incl. events $21,525.44 vs target $11,218 (+92%); D&C PM $10,645.44, DC/AM $1,078, net event sales $9,802, food incl. events $8,412.70. 283 guests (Tock), comps $335.77 (~2.86%). Busy night — garden closed for an event kept downstairs full all night; went on a wait at various points with a full rail. Two events: Vail Resorts media event (35 guests, Garden, 5-8pm) with perfect weather and a buffet spread by Rachael; JPMorgan Chase networking event (45 guests, Vauxhall, 6-9pm) with panel — both hosts thanked the team. Kitchen steady for Rand, Marvin and Nate. Maintenance: a Vauxhall table worse for wear (logged). Favorite moment: walking in and jumping right into a bustling Thursday night.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thursday 7/23** MOD/Chef: Kyler / Steves. Weather: not-so-muggy summer evening. Net sales $6,762 vs target $5,742 (beat by ~17.8%). Beverage $6,011, food $751, retail $0, events $0. 211 guests, $32 check avg. Comps $236.25 (investors, friends, service recoveries). Room filled out healthily after a massive 6pm line of two-tops; subsequent turns two-top heavy with a few larger groups keeping energy lively. Moderately busy until midnight; final hour quiet aside from bar regulars. Door: bumping Thursday — full after the large 8pm turn, medium waitlist (~1hr) cleared by 10pm, bar mostly sat until 12:30am. Lots of superfans and industry guests (visitors from London/Equal Parts, Mace, Broadway, Dutchkills, Kafana); regulars Evan Saez, Braxton, Sarju, member Ben Dedrick. No no-shows. Top sellers: Rosalie, Burner Phone, Peacemaker. Menu 20/20; breakage: Collins. Entered by Sean.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thursday 7/23.** MOD Gigi / Chef Saleh. Net $5,793 vs target $6,196 (-7%). 147 guests, comps $155.50 (employee discounts, anniversary bubbles, service recovery for 86'd cookies). A slower Thursday than usual but a fun one — lots of celebrations and returning guests. Gracy's second night at the host stand and she crushed it, riding solo most of the evening. Consistent from 9pm onward but never hit typical Thursday pace; cut Rave ~11:15pm, a handful of late seatings ~11:45pm with food orders, bar full and lively until a dramatic dwindle after last call; last guest out before 1am. Kitchen: shoutout to Saleh's patience at last call — lots of chicken, tartare, cheese plates and shrimp toast. 86: whole milk, final cookie order (frozen). Favorite moment: first ticket of the night — 18 oysters.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Thursday 7/23.** MOD Marcus. Net $3,824.91 vs target $4,931 (-22%). 96 guests (65 walk-in / 31 reso), $39.84 avg, comps $3.60 (F&F). Slow start used to ABK the chemical closet and clear the ADA entrance. All-star bartender team rotating barback duties; room gained momentum and by 9pm both dining room and bar were full. Tyler ran the floor solo with support from the bar team, Devan and Marcus. A five-top convention group was sent over by San Lorenzo's GM Christina. Last call 11:30pm, smooth wrap. Maintenance: curtains off rails, party pod light bulb, service drains slow. Favorite moment: returning guest Bardia found his bottle of Fumus Pumila Smoked Apple to make 'Monument Valley' back home in Arizona.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Thursday 7/23.** AM MOD Sam & Chef Lex; PM MOD Justin & Shannon. Net $5,666 vs target $5,600 (+1%). Guests: 36 morning + 104 evening (OpenTable). Splits: Municipal Bar AM $774, PM $4,952, Sun Club $505, Hot Eye $569. Comps $178. Quiet morning (busiest hour 12-1 at ~$300); evening was consistently steady — about eight tables at a time with the bar half full, slowing by 8:30 with a last-minute pop of drinkers before close. Sun Club slow and hot early, trickling in with check-ins by 3pm — mostly drink tabs, new shelf labels installed; AC unit may need to run constant instead of auto. Hot Eye tame — never empty, never more than 15 in. Kitchen smooth — one DNL chicken swapped masterfully for a steak, one steak recovery. Favorite moment: the Wonders of Southern Cross family dinner, and Justin's friend Lauren checking in for the weekend from Atlanta.
